No. 1906/48 – FRIDAY, MARCH 20, 2015
EXTRAORDINARY
THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460) Notice under Section 7

Land Ministry’s Ref. No.: LD/05/2007/MV/110D. I, hereby give notice, under sub-Section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, as Amended by the Land Acquisition (Amendment) Act, No. 28 of 1964 that the Government intends to acquire the following land which is required for a public purpose.
Description of the Land to be acquired: Public purpose means the land acquisition for the Moragahakanda and Kaluganga Development Project.

The lands described below, shown in sheet No. 83 of supplement 29 in F. Topo PP 17 approved by Surveyor General dated on 20.11.2014, situated at Thalagoda Village in Thalagoda Grama Niladhari Division of Gangala Pallesiya Pattuwa, Naula Divisional Secretary’s Division, Matale District, Central Province.
01. Lot No. 3679 Name of Land: Kummbukgollayaaya Nohoth Kumbukgolla; Description of Land: Estate; Claimant: State; Possessed by: V. W. M. Heenbanda of Kumbukgolla, Thalagoda; Extent: 0.1678 Hectare.
02. Lot No. 3680 Name of Land: Kummbukgollayaaya Nohoth Kumbukgolla; Description of Land: Light Forest; Claimant: State; Extent: 0.0213 Hectare.
03. Lot No. 3681 Name of Land: Kummbukgollayaaya Nohoth Kumbukgolla; Description of Land: Light Forest; Claimant: Elosiyas Noyanal Deniyal of Thalagoda Junction, Thalagoda; Extent: 0.0693 Hectare.

04. Lot No. 3682 Name of Land: Kummbukgollayaaya Nohoth Kumbukgolla; Description of Land: Garden; Claimant: Elosiyas Noyanal Deniyal of Thalagoda Junction, Thalagoda; Possessed by: V. W. M. Heenbanda of Kumbukgolla, Thalagoda; Extent: 0.1202 Hectare.

05. Lot No. 3683 Name of Land: Kummbukgollayaaya Nohoth Kumbukgolla; Description of Land: Chena; Claimant: Elosiyas Noyanal Deniyal of Thalagoda Junction, Thalagoda; Possessed by: V. W. M. Heenbanda of Kumbukgolla, Thalagoda; Extent: 0.0193 Hectare.

06. Lot No. 3684 Name of Land: Kummbukgollayaaya Nohoth Kumbukgolla; Description of Land: Chena; Claimant: Wedhakaara Gedara Baalayaa (Deceased) of 9th Mile Post, Thalagoda Junction, Kadawatha; Possessed by: V. W. M. Heenbanda of Kumbukgolla, Thalagoda; Extent: 0.0023 Hectare.

07. Lot No. 3685 Name of Land: Kummbukgollayaaya Nohoth Kumbukgolla; Description of Land: Light Forest; Claimant: Wedhakaara Gedara Baalayaa (Deceased) of 9th Mile Post, Thalagoda Junction, Kadawatha; Extent: 0.2033 Hectare.

All persons interested in the aforesaid land are hereby required to appear personally, or by agents before me at 9.00 a.m. on the 29th day of April, 2015 at the Naula Divisional Secretariat.

And further you are hereby requested to notify to me in writing (in duplicate) on or before the 22nd day of April, 2015 the nature of their interests in the Land, the particulars of their claims for compensation of the acquisition of the said, land, the amount of compensation and the details of the computation of such amount.
D. R. B. N. B. KARUNATHILAKE, Divisional Secretary, Naula.
Divisional Secretariat, Naula, 12th March, 2015. 04 - 194/1
